segments.an3.50:1.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati, nillopampi harati, ekāgārikampi karoti, paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
segments.an3.50:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito ca hoti, gahananissito ca hoti, balavanissito ca hoti.
segments.an3.50:1.5: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.
segments.an3.50:1.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro tiṇagahanaṃ vā nissito hoti, rukkhagahanaṃ vā rodhaṃ [gedhaṃ (sī. pī.)] vā mahāvanasaṇḍaṃ vā.
segments.an3.50:2.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro gahananissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:3.2: Idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:3.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī’ti.
segments.an3.50:3.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
segments.an3.50:3.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, mahācoro balavanissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:3.7: Ime kho, bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhimpi chindati, nillopampi harati, ekāgārikampi karoti, paripanthepi tiṭṭhati.
segments.an3.50:4.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tīhi aṅgehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
segments.an3.50:4.3: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito ca hoti gahananissito ca balavanissito ca.
segments.an3.50:5.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamena kāyakammena samannāgato hoti, visamena vacīkammena samannāgato hoti, visamena manokammena samannāgato hoti.
segments.an3.50:5.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu visamanissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:6.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu micchādiṭṭhiko hoti, antaggāhikāya diṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti.
segments.an3.50:6.3: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu gahananissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:7.2: Idha, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu rājānaṃ vā rājamahāmattānaṃ vā nissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:7.4: ‘sace maṃ koci kiñci vakkhati, ime me rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantī’ti.
segments.an3.50:7.5: Sace naṃ koci kiñci āha, tyāssa rājāno vā rājamahāmattā vā pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
segments.an3.50:7.6: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pāpabhikkhu balavanissito hoti.
segments.an3.50:7.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato pāpabhikkhu khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati, sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo ca viññūnaṃ, bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavatī”ti.

lines: Nadīvidugganti nadīnaṃ duggamaṭṭhānaṃ antaradīpakaṃ, yattha sakkā hoti dvīhipi tīhipi jaṅghasahassehi saddhiṃ nilīyituṃ.
Pabbatavisamanti pabbatānaṃ visamaṭṭhānaṃ pabbatantaraṃ, yattha sakkā hoti sattahi vā aṭṭhahi vā jaṅghasahassehi saddhiṃ nilīyituṃ.
Pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇissantīti pariyodahitvā taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ pakkhipitvā atthaṃ kathayissanti.

Pariyodhāya atthaṃ bhaṇantīti kismiñci kiñci vattuṃ āraddheyeva “mā evaṃ avacuttha, mayaṃ etaṃ kulaparamparāya jānāma, na esa evarūpaṃ karissatī”ti taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ pakkhipitvā mahantampi dosaṃ harantā atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
Te hi tassapi dosaṃ paṭicchādetvā atthaṃ bhaṇanti.
Balavacoroti ca mahāthāmatāya mahāparivāratāya mahācoriyakammasamatthatāya ca veditabbo.
Taṃ taṃ kāraṇaṃ pakkhipitvāti taṃ taṃ akaraṇameva kāraṇaṃ katvā tappaṭibaddhāya kathāya pakkhipitvā.
Antaṃ gahetvā ṭhitadiṭṭhiyāti tameva sassatādiantaṃ gahetvā avissajjetvā ṭhitadiṭṭhiyā.
